blocking_findings.problem: Only type/size/domain count is checked. A retained target key can be changed to an unknown32B BLOB or the existing genesis32B BLOB with payload unchanged. The metadata scan accepts it; the original target lookup becomes None, and hot active/target public read can reconstruct a correct complete State from KV/COW/deltas. Cold audit then visits the damaged present row and rejects unknown block or genesis/binding. Correct State is not proof that damaged present index was rejected.

Production guard is not demonstrated failed by this; the source control itself contradicts existing isolation.
